RRB Group D PET Result 2026

The RRB Group D PET Result for the candidates who have appeared in the Physical Efficiency Test under CEN No. RRC-08/2024. The result is available in PDF format and contains the roll numbers of candidates who have qualified the PET round. Candidates who clear this stage will be shortlisted for the Document Verification (DV) and Medical Examination as per the recruitment process. What After RRB Group D Physical Test Result 2026?

Candidates who qualify the RRB Group D Physical Efficiency Test (PET) will be called for the Document Verification (DV) round by their respective Railway Recruitment Cells (RRCs). During DV, candidates must produce all original educational, identity, category, and other required certificates for verification. After successful document verification, candidates will undergo the Medical Examination to assess their fitness for the post. The final selection will be made only after candidates clear both the Document Verification and Medical Examination stages.

FAQs on RRB Group D PET Result 2026

Q1. Is the RRB Group D PET Result 2026 declared?
 Ans. Yes, the RRB Group D PET Result 2026 was declared on 26th and 30th July 2026 in PDF format.

Q2. How can I download the RRB Group D Physical Test Result 2026 PDF?
 Ans. Candidates can download the RRB Group D Physical Test Result 2026 PDF from the respective RRC official website.

Q3. What details are mentioned in the RRB Group D PET Result PDF 2026?
 Ans. The result PDF contains the roll numbers of candidates who have qualified the Physical Efficiency Test (PET).

Q4. What is the next stage after the RRB Group D PET Result 2026?
 Ans. Qualified candidates will be called for Document Verification (DV) followed by the Medical Examination.

Q5. On which date was the RRB Group D PET 2026 conducted?
 Ans. The RRB Group D Physical Efficiency Test (PET) 2026 was conducted on 25th July 2026.
